## Technical Skill Taxonomy

### 1. Browser Extension Architecture (Manifest V3)
- **Core APIs:** Manifest V3, chrome.runtime, chrome.tabs, chrome.storage (local/session/sync), chrome.sidePanel, chrome.offscreen, declarativeNetRequest (DNR), chrome.alarms, chrome.scripting.
- **Architecture Patterns:** Service worker keep-alive engineering (offscreen documents & alarm schedules), Shadow DOM closed-root style isolation, cross-context message passing, dual-world script execution (Main World + Isolated World).
- **Store Compliance:** Chrome Web Store Single Purpose Policy, permission minimization, automated ZIP bundling, privacy policy generation, Edge Add-ons & Opera compatibility.

### 2. AI Browser Copilots & Vision Extraction
- **LLM Integrations:** OpenAI GPT-4o / GPT-4o-mini streaming, Google Gemini 1.5 Pro / Flash, Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet via Server-Sent Events (SSE).
- **RAG & Vector Search:** In-memory vector embeddings, client-side semantic search, IndexedDB persistence, live DOM table & document extraction.
- **Vision & OCR:** Canvas-based viewport capture, snip-and-scroll full-page screenshots, Tesseract.js client-side OCR parsing, VIN/document extraction.

### 3. High-Frequency Browser Automation & Web Scraping
- **Sniping & Bot Physics:** Sub-second WebSocket listeners, dynamic CSRF token discovery, Bezier curve mouse trajectory humanization with Gaussian dwell timing (< 0.01% ban rate).
- **ATS Automation:** Automated multi-step job application auto-apply across 100+ ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Workday, Ashby, Lever, Oracle). Engineered working Ashby integration in 1 week after 20+ prior developers failed.
- **Data Piping:** Direct background extraction to Google Sheets (Google Apps Script), Airtable, Notion, Supabase, and PostgreSQL.

### 4. Full-Stack SaaS & Web Development
- **Frontend:** Next.js 15/16 (App Router, Server Actions, SSR), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Motion.
- **Backend & APIs:** Node.js, Express, REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, Supabase, Firebase, PostgreSQL (Prisma & Drizzle ORM), Redis caching.
- **Monetization & Auth:** Stripe Billing (tiered subscriptions, metered usage, customer portals, webhook idempotency), ExtensionPay, LemonSqueezy, Clerk, Supabase Auth, NextAuth.
- **Web3 & Crypto:** Solana Web3.js, Phantom & Solflare wallet SDKs, Helius RPC, X402 HTTP micro-payments.
